sonnet.problem: The opening story card says Jesus had just taught about money and quotes "You cannot serve both God and money." This gives away the answer to the very next choice card (card 2), which asks what the Pharisees were lovers of ("Money").
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The question asks what Jesus' picture of a pen stroke dropping out of the Law means, and the right answer ("Every bit of it still stands") is the card's own interpretation. The passage doesn't say what the picture stands for. The wrong answer "It came to an end with John" also takes a side on how verse 16 and verse 17 connect. The question also restates the quoted picture from card 9, so the answer is nearly given.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect. This includes what a picture means. He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so.
